cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:0fb079a4-8697-47.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:7bc9cc58-9.description: Be Part of Our Next Chapter For over almost 60 years, our solutions have enabled impactful connections between some of the world’s leading brands and their customers. And while we’ve already done a lot of work we’re proud of, we’re just getting started! We’re a global technology company focused on creating dynamic, smart, personalised and engaging customer experiences powered by our range of digital hardware, our proprietary content management system and our industry leading signage solutions. (For example: If you’ve ordered in-store or in the drive-thru at McDonald’s somewhere in the world in the last few years, chances are you’ve interacted with our digital solutions.) We work in over 50 global markets and have 9 offices around the world, with a global headquarters proudly located in our founding home of Sydney, Australia. Coates Group has the values of a family-owned business and the innovative spirit of a start-up, both which fuel our purpose – Creating Connections. Empowering Partnerships. Always Evolving. Through hard work, dedication and creativity, we’ve become industry leaders who have won awards and set records while remaining focused on continual growth and evolution. We are a 2x Australia Good Design Award winner and successfully completed the largest hardware deployment in Quick Service Restaurant history. We are curious, charismatic, authentic and we value and leverage the diversity of our crew. We are imaginers, kindness enthusiasts, experts, creators, thinkers, challengers, collaborators and over-achievers. And together, as a Crew, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s leading brands leverage technology to drive the best customer experiences. The Director, Account Management is accountable for the overall health, performance, and long-term success of the account. This role sets strategic direction, provides guidance and decision making for the account team, and ensures the account is positioned for sustainable delivery, optimization, and growth. The Director, Account Management acts as the senior client partner and internal decision authority, balancing client needs, team capacity, and business objectives.
responsibilities: Strategic Client Partnership
Serve as the senior client partner and trusted advisor.
Shape client direction through proactive recommendations and strategic counsel.
Represent Coates in senior client discussions.
Campaign & Delivery Leadership
Ensure campaign recommendations align with business objectives.
Drive strategic alignment across client and internal teams.
Minimize ambiguity and rework through clear direction.
Team Leadership & Capability
Lead and develop the Account Management team.
Align cross-functional teams around priorities.
Foster a culture of ownership and strategic thinking.
Commercial & Operational Stewardship
Ensure sustainable account performance through effective scope and resource management.
Anticipate and resolve risks early.
Demonstrate strategic value through meaningful reporting.
Account Growth & Evolution
Identify opportunities to strengthen and expand the partnership.
Evolve the account model to meet future client needs.
Partner with leadership to support long-term commercial success.
qualifications: 7–10 years of experience in account management, client services, or digital marketing, preferably in an agency environment.
Background in digital marketing, content, or retail/QSR merchandising is a strong asset.
Proven ability to bring a strategic point of view to clients — not just manage deliverables.
Experience working within retainer-based models and managing a stable, high-volume book of work.
Comfortable managing two or more direct reports and providing day-to-day direction.
Strong presentation skills — can communicate strategy clearly to marketers and senior clients alike.
Familiarity with project management tools and content delivery workflows; PM experience an asset but not required.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:96274bdc-0efb-.title: QE Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:96274bdc-0efb-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QE Engineer based in India. This role is focused on building quality into the software development lifecycle through structured testing and quality engineering practices. You will work closely with development and product teams to understand business requirements and translate them into effective test strategies. The position combines test planning, automation, continuous testing, and validation across large-scale distributed software environments. You will contribute throughout the full project lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, execution, and evaluation. The role offers the opportunity to work with modern engineering practices including Agile, DevOps, BDD, and automated testing frameworks. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams while taking ownership of quality engineering activities with minimal supervision. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced QA professional who enjoys solving complex testing challenges and improving software reliability. Participate in requirements gathering and software design phases to develop a thorough understanding of business requirements and ensure testing strategies address business needs. Design comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and quality engineering approaches aligned with project requirements. Implement established quality engineering processes throughout the software development lifecycle, including planning, design, implementation, execution, and evaluation. Develop and execute automated and manual testing activities across large-scale, distributed software environments. Apply behavior-driven development and automation practices to improve test coverage, repeatability, and software quality. Collaborate with developers, product teams, and other stakeholders to identify potential quality risks and ensure requirements are effectively validated. Support continuous testing and DevOps practices by integrating quality activities into development and deployment workflows. Perform database and data validation testing where required, ensuring application behavior and underlying data meet expected requirements. Use relevant testing, development, and product management tools to document, track, and communicate testing activities and results. Contribute to model-based testing and other structured quality engineering methodologies. Work independently on assigned quality engineering activities while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, automation coverage, and overall software quality. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in enterprise software testing, preferably within large-scale distributed software environments. Hands-on experience with technologies and frameworks such as Gherkin, REST Assured, Java, and Apache POI. At least 2 years of experience working with Agile methodologies, tools, and quality engineering practices. Experience with GitHub, DevOps, Jenkins, Playwright, BDD automation, database testing, continuous testing, and model-based testing. Familiarity with product and application lifecycle management tools such as RTC, RQM, Jira, Client ALM, or Rally. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and quality engineering processes across the full development lifecycle. Ability to design effective test plans and scenarios based on business and technical requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify defects, quality risks, and potential gaps in requirements. Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability for assigned deliverables. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a cross-functional engineering team. Experience with ETL testing is an advantage. Working knowledge of SQL is preferred. Comfo

jobgether-jobgether:lever:9cc7d213-869a-.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand
jobgether-jobgether:lever:9cc7d213-869a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in South Africa. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. Direct experience across multiple operational functions, including supply chain, inventory, 3PL/fulfillment, customer support operations, creative, and growth teams. Demonstrated experience building a department, function, operating system, hiring process, reporting infrastructure, or other business capability from the ground up. Strong understanding of physical-product operations, including lead times, purchase orders, landed costs, inventory, fulfillment, manufacturing, and 3PL relationship

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e26f46cb-6a66-.title: Staff Quality Assurance Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e26f46cb-6a66-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Quality Assurance Engineer based in United States. This is a high-impact staff-level engineering role focused on elevating quality across a modern, distributed SaaS product environment. You will own automated testing strategy and frameworks across multiple product teams and critical customer journeys. The role combines hands-on coding, test architecture, quality enablement, and cross-functional technical leadership. You will help shift quality ownership directly into engineering while building reliable, measurable testing practices. A major focus will be using AI, APIs, and MCP-based tooling to make complex testing faster and more repeatable. You will influence engineering practices across teams without acting as a manual testing gatekeeper. This is an opportunity to shape a quality engineering practice from the ground up and deliver measurable improvements in product reliability. Own the automated testing strategy and frameworks across the UI product, initially focusing on high-risk resident onboarding flows before expanding coverage to additional product areas. Build critical-user-flow coverage into engineering delivery pipelines so automated testing is owned and maintained by development teams. Establish a risk-weighted registry of critical flows and create live dashboards measuring test coverage, screen coverage, and relevant production traffic. Develop and promote an AI-first approach to quality engineering, using Claude, MCP-based tooling, APIs, CLIs, and direct data access to automate complex and repetitive testing scenarios. Modernize integration testing by replacing manual partner verification with API-driven automation and addressing environment and testability gaps. Coach engineers, product managers, and stakeholders on quality practices, embedding testing into product design and code review rather than relying on downstream manual validation. Lead the Quality Enablement practice by identifying and prioritizing tooling, infrastructure, and system-testability improvements across engineering teams. Establish durable quality guardrails, including CI coverage targets, deployment-gate health monitoring, flaky-test reduction, and escaped-defect tracking. Partner across engineering, platform, product, and leadership teams to improve testing capabilities and make quality outcomes measurable. Use data and production signals to identify quality trends, reduce defects reaching production, and continuously improve engineering reliability. Requirements: Staff-level engineering experience with a strong track record of designing, coding, and owning automated testing frameworks across unit, integration, contract, browser, and end-to-end testing layers. Quality engineering must be a core area of expertise and professional focus, with demonstrated experience building sophisticated automated testing systems rather than primarily performing manual QA. Strong programming skills with AWS and Node/TypeScript, plus the ability to work comfortably across distributed, service-oriented systems and service boundaries. Experience with modern testing technologies such as Jest, Playwright, contract testing, API testing, and automated integration testing. Strong interest and practical experience using AI to improve engineering workflows, with enthusiasm for building agent workflows, skills, and MCP-based tooling. Exceptional communication and coaching abilities, with the ability to influence engineers, product managers, technical leaders, and non-technical stakeholders across multiple teams. Demonstrated autonomy and ownership, including the ability to identify ambiguous quality problems, establish priorities, and deliver measurable improvements with limited process overhead. Ability to work a consistent 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST schedule. Comfortable working in a remote-first environment with reliable high-speed intern

travix-travix:greenhouse:8500090002.description: Step into a world where data and creativity come together, and where your work directly impacts how millions of travelers book their journeys. As a Marketing & E-commerce Intern at Travix, you will dive into the dynamic world of website optimization, content management, and digital growth for brands like Flugladen.de and CheapTickets.ch. This is your opportunity to learn how international travel brands operate behind the scenes and to make a real impact on our upcoming campaigns. Who are we looking for? We are looking for an enthusiastic Marketing & E-commerce Intern for a period of 6 months. You are curious, creative, eager to learn, and enjoy a challenge. With your data-driven mindset, creative thinking, and hands-on attitude, you will thrive in a fast-paced, international environment. What will you do? As a Marketing & E-commerce Intern, you will play an active role in shaping the experience travelers have when booking their next adventure. Your responsibilities will include: Supporting content management and content strategy, including involvement in executing campaign plans Assisting with website optimization and learning how it impacts customer journeys and conversion rates Collaborating with the Partnerships team to manage relationships with airlines and other partners Learning how to create performance analyses and reports, and translating them into actionable insights for optimization Contributing creative ideas to improve the online travel experience across the website and social media Exploring how AI can be applied effectively across different processes What do you bring? Strong communication skills (both written and verbal) A proactive, hands-on mindset Analytical thinking and an interest in data Creativity and attention to detail, with an affinity for social media and trends Interest in marketing and the travel industry Interest in AI and new technologies Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program during the internship period Availability to work 2–3 days per week from the office (Amsterdam Bijlmer) Fluency in English is a must. Fluent in German is a big advantage. What do we offer? Hybrid working with flexibility and a healthy work-life balance The opportunity to work abroad for a few days (upon agreement) An open and informal work environment where your ideas matter An international team with over 50 nationalities Travel expense reimbursement A modern and vibrant office in Amsterdam Bijlmer Arena Free fruit, snacks, team outings, and events About Travix Travix is one of the world’s largest online travel organizations, with brands such as CheapTickets, Vliegwinkel, and BudgetAir. As part of Trip.com Group, we operate globally in more than 40 countries. Our mission? To make travel accessible anytime, anywhere. Ready to make an impact in the world of online travel? Apply now and start your journey with Travix!
